ROLE:
Job Title: Test Engineer – SAP Success Factors (EC, ONB, RCM) Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform end-to-end testing for SAP Success Factors Employee Central (EC) and related integrations. Design, execute, and maintain test cases for Functional, Integration, and Regression Testing. Validate business requirements and ensure high-quality application delivery. Identify, log, track, and verify defects using tools such as JIRA, Azure Dev Ops (ADO), q Test, or similar. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and client stakeholders in an Agile Scrum environment. Prepare test plans, execution reports, defect summaries, and testing status updates. Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and release validation activities. Quickly understand application functionality and adapt to evolving business requirements.

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience in SAP Success Factors Testing with primary expertise in Employee Central (EC) . Strong knowledge of Functional Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, and defect lifecycle management. Experience working in Agile Scrum teams with direct client interaction. Hands-on experience with JIRA, Azure Dev Ops (ADO), q Test, or similar test management tools. Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills. Desired Qualifications (Optional): Experience with Employee Central Payroll (ECP), Position Management, Business Rules, MDF, or Time Management modules. Exposure to SAP Success Factors integrations and API testing. Knowledge of test automation tools/frameworks. ISTQB or relevant testing certifications. Experience in HR domain or SAP Success Factors implementation projects. Location: PAN India (Remote) Want to change the world? Let us know. Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let’s talk!

ROLE:
Job Title: PLM Consultant Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced PLM Consultant with strong expertise in Process Manufacturing to lead PLM implementation, enhancement, and support initiatives. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of product lifecycle processes across Food & Beverage, Dairy, Ingredients, CPG, Chemicals, or Life Sciences industries. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead PLM implementation, enhancement, rollout, and support projects. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and design effective PLM solutions. Configure and support processes including Formula/Recipe Management, Product Specifications, Ingredient & Raw Material Management, Packaging, Change Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Product Data Management. Support integrations between PLM and ERP/MES/QMS/LIMS applications. Participate in solution design, testing, deployment, user training, and production support. Drive continuous process improvements and PLM best practices. Required Skills: 8+ years of experience in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM). Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: Selerant Dev EX PLM (Process Manufacturing) Trace Gains PLM (Process Manufacturing) Lascom CPG PLM (Process Manufacturing) Centric PLM (Process Manufacturing) Infor Optiva PLM (Process Manufacturing) SAP PLM (Process Manufacturing) Siemens Teamcenter PLM (Process Manufacturing) PTC Windchill PLM (Process Manufacturing) Strong knowledge of Process Manufacturing business processes and product lifecycle management. Experience integrating PLM with ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.) is an added advantage. Strong analytical, consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working in Agile delivery environments is preferred. What We Are Looking For: Strong functional understanding of Process Manufacturing and PLM concepts, irrespective of the PLM platform. Demonstrated ability and positive attitude to quickly learn, adapt, and implement new PLM platforms and emerging technologies. Growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning, innovation, and solving complex business problems. Ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional teams. We are looking for a candidate who is interested or willingness to learn Infor Optiva tool Location: Bangalore, Pune Want to change the world? Let us know. Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let’s talk!

We partner with Global 2000 clients across North America, UK, Europe, and APAC to solve complex challenges in data, experience design, software product engineering, and workforce transformation. Come, change the world with us: · Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands · Solve complex problems – and learn new skills · Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients · Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience Experience a community of change makers! Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion. About the

ROLE:
We are seeking an experienced Service Delivery Director with a strong Application Support background and deep exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles. The role is responsible for end-to-end service delivery of large-scale, mission-critical applications, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance through proactive monitoring, observability, incident management, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate brings hands-on understanding of production environments, leads 24/7 support operations, drives SLO/SLA adherence, and applies SRE best practices to reduce MTTR and MTTD, improve system resilience, and enhance customer experience. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Service Delivery & Operations Own end-to-end service delivery for multiple critical applications, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance across production environments. Lead 24/7 application support operations (L2/L3), including on-call rotations, incident bridges, escalations, and stakeholder communications. Act as the primary escalation point for major incidents, driving resolution until closure and RCA sign-off. Ensure consistent adherence to SLAs, OLAs, and KPIs, with continuous tracking and reporting. SRE & Reliability Engineering Apply SRE principles to application support, including: Definition and tracking of SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets Improving reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance Drive initiatives to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) through automation, improved alerting, and runbooks. Partner with engineering teams to eliminate toil and improve operational efficiency. Monitoring, Observability & AIOps Lead the design and adoption of monitoring and observability platforms using tools such as: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace, Open Telemetry (OTel) Ensure end-to-end visibility across infrastructure, applications, and business transactions. Implement proactive monitoring, intelligent alerting, and anomaly detection to prevent incidents before business impact. Drive adoption of AIOps and automated incident management (auto-remediation, automated runbooks where applicable). Incident, Problem & Change Management Lead Major Incident Management (MIM) including war rooms, stakeholder updates, and executive reporting. Ensure timely and high-quality Root Cause Analysis (RCA) with preventive action plans. Govern problem management to identify recurring issues and drive long-term fixes. Oversee change and release management, ensuring minimal risk to production systems. Stakeholder & Vendor Management Act as a trusted partner for business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and clients. Communicate service health, risks, and improvement plans to senior leadership. Manage third-party vendors and support partners, ensuring contract compliance and service quality. Continuous Improvement & Transformation Drive operational excellence initiatives to improve uptime, performance, and customer satisfaction. Lead transformation programs involving cloud migration, Dev Ops, and SRE adoption. Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and operational cost. Support DR planning, testing, and compliance with RTO/RPO requirements. Required Experience & Skills Experience 15+ years of experience in Application Support / Production Operations, with 5+ years in a Service Delivery / SRE / Operations Leadership role. Job Description: We are looking for a Principal Architect to take hands-on ownership of the most technically complex parts of the platform: How data flows in, how AI makes decisions, and how the platform talks to enterprise tools. This is not a strategy or advisory role. You will be doing the actual design and technical decision-making, writing specifications that engineering teams build against, and setting the technical bar for how things get built. You will work independently with a high degree of trust, and the broader team will look to you as the technical authority in your areas. Experience: 10+ Years Work Mode: Hybrid Technical Skills & Requirements:
1. Experience • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 3 years working as a senior or principal-level architect or engineer • A track record of designing and shipping systems that run at enterprise scale in production — not just prototypes or internal tools • Experience building platforms or frameworks that other engineers build on top of, not just application-level features • Comfortable working across multiple programming languages — ideally Java, Python, or Node.js 2.Data & Real-Time Systems • Experience building pipelines that process large volumes of real-time data reliably • Familiarity with message streaming platforms such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs • Understanding of how to handle failures, retries, and recovery in data pipelines without losing data 3.AI & Intelligent Systems • Hands-on experience integrating AI or large language models into real production systems — not just experimentation • Understanding of how to build AI workflows that chain multiple steps together and use external tools • Awareness of the trade-offs between running AI models yourself versus using a managed AI service • Experience building systems that retrieve relevant context to make AI outputs more accurate 4.Integrations & APIs • Experience designing frameworks or platforms that connect to many different third-party tools in a consistent way • Strong understanding of how enterprise authentication and security works when connecting to external systems • Ability to design integrations that are reliable, recoverable, and easy to monitor • Familiarity with enterprise IT tools such as Service Now, Jira, or similar platforms

jobDescription: Job Description: Job Description: Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer Location: Bangalore, KA/ Chennai, TN/ Pune, MH/ Hyderabad, TN Working Hours: Ideal overlap with U.S. team from 8:00–11:00 AM PST Position Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer to join our team. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles as applied to BI dashboards and reports. Proven ability to integrate Power BI with SQL Server, Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure. Experience with large language models (LLMs) for natural language querying and interpretation in BI environments. Experience guiding data architecture and engineering teams (not necessarily performing data engineering tasks). Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. title: Java Fullstack Engineer
minimumQualification: Experience should include state management patterns (e.g., Redux or equivalent), hooks, and building performant, reusable UI components.
jobDescription: Role Summary The Full Stack Developer will contribute across the end-to-end delivery lifecycle, spanning front-end (React.js/Java Script) and back-end (Java/Spring, microservices, integration) , while also supporting production incident analysis and remediation. The role requires strong engineering discipline, ownership, and the ability to deliver change safely in a high-control financial environment. Key Responsibilities The role is responsible for delivering new functionality and enhancing existing capabilities across the full stack, from user-facing interfaces through to service and integration layers. The developer will also support production operations, including root-cause analysis, code remediation, performance tuning, and controlled release execution. This position requires consistent collaboration with business stakeholders, QA, and globally distributed technology teams, with a focus on high-quality delivery, test automation, secure coding, and compliance with bank policies Experience Required Candidates must demonstrate proven experience in Java/J2EE and microservices development, with strong hands-on capability in React.js and modern Java Script (ES6+) for building component-based user interfaces. Experience should include state management patterns (e.g., Redux or equivalent), hooks, and building performant, reusable UI components. The role requires experience with at least one RDBMS such as Oracle or DB2 , as well as enterprise integration and batch patterns, including Apache Camel and Spring Batch . Strong knowledge of the Spring Framework and Hibernate is required, along with messaging technologies such as MQ / JMS / Kafka to support reliable message transfer processes (per role description). Candidates should be proficient with common engineering toolchains including Intelli J/Eclipse , Maven , and Git , and demonstrate disciplined unit testing practices using JUnit as well as front-end testing approaches (e.g., Jest and React Testing Library or equivalent). Experience with Web Services / REST APIs is required, including integrating React front ends with back-end services and handling API contracts responsibly. The role requires hands-on exposure to Unix / Shell scripting , performance tuning and response time optimization, and familiarity with secure development practices including code scanning tools such as Black Duck and Sonar Qube (per role description). Candidates should also have an understanding of banking risk and compliance policies and prior experience building financial applications involving transaction processing, settlement, and accounting (per role description). Familiarity with modern front-end build and dependency tooling (e.g., npm/Yarn , Webpack or equivalent), and working knowledge of CI/CD and Dev Ops-aligned delivery practices are expected to support reliable delivery across environments.

title: Program Manager
minimumQualification: Experience in quality governance, defect management, and integration processes.
jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly driven Technical Project Manager (TPM) to lead end-to-end delivery and release execution for Connectivity programs. This role is critical in ensuring seamless alignment across multiple engineering tracks, driving disciplined release management, and maintaining high quality standards across both NPI and Fleet initiatives. The TPM will operate at the intersection of engineering, program management, and leadership—ensuring that scope, priorities, risks, and dependencies are proactively managed to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. Key Responsibilities
1. Release Backlog Management Own and drive epic prioritization, backlog grooming, and release planning aligned to business priorities. Balance risk, engineering capacity, and quality impact to optimize delivery outcomes. Ensure backlog transparency, traceability, and readiness for execution across all release cycles.
2. Cross-Program Liaison Act as the primary interface between JEDI, Jo LT (NPI & Fleet) TPMs, and Connectivity leadership. Drive alignment on scope, interdependencies, timelines, and risks across multiple programs. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to remove blockers and ensure synchronized execution.
3. Program Status Reporting Provide clear, concise, and actionable updates to leadership on release progress. Highlight key risks, mitigation plans, and decision points to enable informed leadership actions. Establish a consistent reporting cadence with metrics-driven insights (delivery, quality, risk).
4. Integration Approvals & Quality Control Enforce integration checkpoints and quality gates throughout the release lifecycle. Ensure all code integrations meet stability, performance, and regression standards before promotion. Proactively identify and mitigate risks that could lead to late-cycle instability or release delays.
5. Defect Review Board (DRB) Facilitation Lead Defect Review Boards (DRBs) to ensure effective triage and prioritization of issues. Drive clear ownership, accountability, and timely resolution of Connectivity defects. Monitor defect trends and implement corrective actions to improve overall product quality. Required Skills & Qualifications Proven experience as a Technical Project/Program Manager in complex, multi-team environments. Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and release management practices. Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional dependencies and large-scale program execution. Experience in quality governance, defect management, and integration processes. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with engineering teams and senior leadership. Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a focus on data-driven decision making. Success Metrics (KPIs) On-time and predictable release delivery Reduction in escaped defects and regression issues Improved cross-team dependency resolution time High release stability and quality benchmarks Effective risk mitigation and stakeholder satisfaction

Conduct RCA on directory/network and authorization discrepancies.

minimumQualification: Experience should include state management patterns (e.g., Redux or equivalent), hooks, and building performant, reusable UI components.
jobDescription: Role Summary The Full Stack Developer will contribute across the end-to-end delivery lifecycle, spanning front-end (React.js/Java Script) and back-end (Java/Spring, microservices, integration) , while also supporting production incident analysis and remediation. The role requires strong engineering discipline, ownership, and the ability to deliver change safely in a high-control financial environment. Key Responsibilities The role is responsible for delivering new functionality and enhancing existing capabilities across the full stack, from user-facing interfaces through to service and integration layers. The developer will also support production operations, including root-cause analysis, code remediation, performance tuning, and controlled release execution. This position requires consistent collaboration with business stakeholders, QA, and globally distributed technology teams, with a focus on high-quality delivery, test automation, secure coding, and compliance with bank policies Experience Required Candidates must demonstrate proven experience in Java/J2EE and microservices development, with strong hands-on capability in React.js and modern Java Script (ES6+) for building component-based user interfaces. Experience should include state management patterns (e.g., Redux or equivalent), hooks, and building performant, reusable UI components. The role requires experience with at least one RDBMS such as Oracle or DB2 , as well as enterprise integration and batch patterns, including Apache Camel and Spring Batch . Strong knowledge of the Spring Framework and Hibernate is required, along with messaging technologies such as MQ / JMS / Kafka to support reliable message transfer processes (per role description). Candidates should be proficient with common engineering toolchains including Intelli J/Eclipse , Maven , and Git , and demonstrate disciplined unit testing practices using JUnit as well as front-end testing approaches (e.g., Jest and React Testing Library or equivalent). Experience with Web Services / REST APIs is required, including integrating React front ends with back-end services and handling API contracts responsibly. The role requires hands-on exposure to Unix / Shell scripting , performance tuning and response time optimization, and familiarity with secure development practices including code scanning tools such as Black Duck and Sonar Qube (per role description). Candidates should also have an understanding of banking risk and compliance policies and prior experience building financial applications involving transaction processing, settlement, and accounting (per role description). Familiarity with modern front-end build and dependency tooling (e.g., npm/Yarn , Webpack or equivalent), and working knowledge of CI/CD and Dev Ops-aligned delivery practices are expected to support reliable delivery across environments.

minimumQualification: Experience:
jobDescription:
Role Overview: We are seeking a highly experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Power BI and Data Engineering team. This role requires a strategic thinker with deep technical expertise in data analytics, data engineering, and business intelligence solutions , combined with strong leadership skills to manage and mentor a high-performing team. You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable data solutions, driving BI strategy, and ensuring seamless integration of data platforms to enable actionable insights across the organization. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Leadership & Strategy Lead and mentor a team of data engineers and BI developers. Define and execute the data engineering and BI roadmap aligned with business objectives. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver impactful solutions. Data Engineering & BI Development Must have experience as an Architect in implement robust data pipelines and ETL processes using modern tools and frameworks. Must have experience in Designing and optimizing data models for analytics and reporting. Must have experience in leading teams to Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for business-critical insights. Governance & Quality Establish best practices for data governance, security, and compliance. Ensure high data quality, reliability, and performance across all solutions. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Stay updated with emerging technologies in data engineering and BI. Drive automation and efficiency improvements in data workflows. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. Experience: 12+ years of experience in data engineering, BI development, and analytics . 5+ years in a leadership or managerial role overseeing technical teams. Technical Skills: Expertise in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, dashboard design). Strong experience with data engineering tools (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, SQL Server, etc.). Proficiency in SQL, Python, and ETL frameworks . Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred). Soft Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Data Lake , and Azure Machine Learning , AI-driven analytics . Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Dev Ops practices for data solutions. Key KPIs for an Engineering Manager in this Role
1. Data Engineering & BI Delivery On-Time Project Delivery: Percentage of data engineering and BI projects delivered on or before agreed timelines (Target: ≥95%). Dashboard/Report Accuracy: Accuracy of Power BI dashboards and reports compared to source data (Target: ≥99%). ETL Pipeline Reliability: Uptime and success rate of data pipelines (Target: ≥99.5%).
2. Data Quality & Governance Data Quality Score: Reduction in data errors and inconsistencies across systems (Target: ≤1% error rate). Compliance Adherence: Percentage of data solutions meeting security and compliance standards (Target: 100%).
3. Team Leadership & Development Employee Engagement & Retention: Team satisfaction score and retention rate (Target: ≥90%). Skill Development: Number of team members certified or trained in advanced BI/data engineering tools annually (Target: ≥80%).
4. Business Impact Adoption Rate of BI Solutions: Percentage of business units actively using Power BI dashboards (Target: ≥90%). Decision-Making Efficiency: Reduction in time taken for business decisions due to improved data insights (Target: ≥20% improvement).
5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Automation Initiatives: Number of manual processes automated annually (Target: ≥10). Cost Optimization: Reduction in data infrastructure costs through optimization (Target: ≥15%).

Come, change the world with us: Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands Solve complex problems – and learn new skills Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience Job Description: Role Overview The Pricing Operations role is responsible for developing, validating, and managing pricing models for client engagements. The role ensures alignment between business requirements, financial targets (GPM/TCV), and organizational pricing standards while supporting deal approvals and SOW/Change Order processes. Key Responsibilities
1. Pricing s Financial Modelling · Develop pricing models based on PR (Price to Client) and BR (Bill Rate) inputs · Ensure alignment with target Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and financial guidelines · Validate effort estimates, rates, and cost structures (Onshore, Nearshore, Offshore) · Perform scenario analysis to optimize pricing strategies
2. Deal Support s Commercial Structuring · Support creation of SOWs (Statement of Work) and Change Orders (COs) · Align pricing with deal structure (Fixed Price, TCM, Milestone-based) · Work closely with Sales, Delivery, and Finance teams for deal closure · Ensure pricing consistency with approved business case and opportunity details
3. Governance s Compliance · Ensure all pricing follows internal policies and approval workflows · Validate Salesforce Opportunity IDs, deal details, and documentation completeness · Maintain version control of pricing sheets and avoid uncontrolled changes · Support audit requirements and financial compliance checks
4. Stakeholder Management · Coordinate with: o Sales / Business Teams o Delivery / Project Managers o Finance / Pricing Ops / Deal Desk · Clarify requirements and resolve discrepancies in pricing inputs · Provide timely updates and support approval processes
5. Reporting s Analysis · Track deal metrics such as: o TCV (Total Contract Value) o GPM (%) o Cost vs Revenue breakdown · Highlight risks, margin impacts, and deviations Required Skills s Qualifications Technical Skills · Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced formulas, financial models, pivot tables) · Experience with pricing tools / financial systems / Salesforce · Understanding of cost structures, margins, and revenue models Domain Knowledge · Experience in IT services / consulting / outsourcing pricing models · Experience in Deal Desk / Commercial Operations / Pricing Strategy · Exposure to SOW and contract lifecycle management · Knowledge of: o Fixed Price / TCM / Managed Services models o Onshore / Offshore / Nearshore rate structures Soft Skills · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills · Attention to detail and accuracy · Effective communication and stakeholder management · Ability to work under tight timelines Experience a community of change makers! jobDescription:
Title: Manager
- Procurement Location: Vadodara / Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune Shift: Split Shift (1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST or 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST) Website https://ascendion.com/ About Ascendion Ascendion is a leader in AI-powered software engineering, helping businesses innovate faster, smarter, and with greater impact. We partner with Global 2000 clients across North America, UK, Europe, and APAC to solve complex challenges in data, experience design, software product engineering, and workforce transformation. Powered by expert engineers, thousands of AI agents, and our Engineering to the Power of AI™ (Engineering AI) method, we deliver measurable outcomes that build trust, unlock value, and accelerate growth. Learn more at ascendion.com Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us: Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands Solve complex problems – and learn new skills Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience Job Description: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Procurement Manager to drive end-to-end procurement activities across corporate and business support service categories. The role will be responsible for developing category strategies, managing global supplier relationships, leading sourcing initiatives, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving cost optimization while ensuring compliance and governance standards. Key Responsibilities · Develop and execute global category and sourcing strategies for HR and Professional services aligned with business objectives. · Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including vendor identification, RFx management, proposal evaluation, commercial negotiations, and contract finalization. · Manage and build strong relationships with global suppliers and internal stakeholders across Finance, Legal, HR, Compliance, Administration, and Leadership teams. · Drive supplier performance management through SLAs, KPIs, governance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. · Ensure compliance with procurement policies, risk management frameworks, audit requirements, and corporate governance standards. · Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, process optimization, and cost reduction across assigned categories. · Monitor market trends, industry benchmarks, supplier capabilities, and emerging service delivery models to support informed sourcing decisions. · Support global transformation, outsourcing, and spend management initiatives. · Deliver measurable value through strategic sourcing, supplier innovation, and effective contract management. Required Experience & Qualifications * 10 to 15 years of Exp in end-to-end procurement & strategic sourcing in contingent Acquisition, Employee Benefits, L&D, Talent Acquisition, Audits, Finance & Legal. * Proven experience working with global vendors and stakeholders in a multinational environment. * Strong expertise in category management, supplier relationship management, and procurement strategy. * Comprehensive understanding of the Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle, including: * Stakeholder requirement gathering * Scope of Work (SOW) / Statement of Work definition * Vendor sourcing and evaluation * RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ) management * Commercial negotiations * Contract review and governance * Supplier performance management * Cost optimization and savings delivery * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence decision-making across business functions. * Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and communication skills. Preferred Skills * Experience managing procurement across corporate and business support service categories in HR & Professional Services. * Exposure to global transformation, outsourcing, and spend management programs. * Working knowledge of procurement platforms such as Ariba, SAP, Oracle, or Coupa (preferred). * Strong presentation and stakeholder engagement capabilities. Experience a community of change makers! Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

Job Title: Sr. Partner Sales Operations Executive Job location: Bengaluru/Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune Shift timings: EST/CST (work from home option) Company’s website : www.ascendion.com As a strategic GTM engine, the Partner Alliances Team turns partnerships into growth accelerators—fueling innovation, market presence, and revenue impact. Sitting at the intersection of engineering, marketing, and sales, you will act as the critical connector that fosters seamless collaboration. In this role, you will drive operational rigor, leverage partner incentives, and enable co-sell programs that amplify customer value, accelerate pipeline, and fuel revenue growth. About the

ROLE:
The Partner Alliances team drives the new and scaled Ascendion’s partner ecosystem, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and impact of both new and existing partnerships. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Partner Sales Operations Executive to lead and execute Partner Co-Sell Operations across our strategic ecosystem of cloud and data partners such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake, and Databricks. The partnerships cultivated in this role are not just operational—they directly shape Ascendion’s brand visibility, sales pipeline, and revenue growth. By enabling effective collaboration with Sales and our cloud, data and other partners, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Co-Sell programs, driving customer success, and reinforcing Ascendion’s position as a leader in digital and AI-enabled transformation. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the operational execution of partner Co-Sell activities with a wide range of partners to drive measurable revenue impact. Serve as a trusted liaison with Sales teams, ensuring alignment of pipeline priorities, partner Co-Sell motions, and customer engagement strategies. Develop and maintain partner GTM collateral, Co-Sell materials, and solution playbooks to accelerate field adoption. Leverage partner funding and incentives to enable cost-effective customer proposals and maximize ROI. Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across engineering, sales, marketing, and partner teams to deliver consistency and precision. Track, analyze, and report on pipeline performance, co-sell activities, and program ROI to business and executive stakeholders. Build scalable operational processes that enhance efficiency, reliability, and repeatability across partnerships. Support leadership in shaping strategic GTM initiatives, pipeline acceleration, and ecosystem growth opportunities.

QUALIFICATIONS:
8+ years of experience in partner alliances, sales operations, or program management in the technology industry. Proven track record of driving partner Co-Sell motions and delivering business impact with major partners (esp AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks). Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with Sales teams, aligning GTM strategy with field execution. Foundational understanding of cloud and data platforms and AI-driven solution development, with the ability to leverage Gen AI tools for operational tasks. Strong organizational skills with a reputation for being highly detail-oriented and precise in program execution. Experience leveraging partner incentives, funding, and marketing programs to accelerate pipeline growth. Adept at managing and executing high volumes of operational tasks with influencing stakeholders across sales, business and technological functions in a matrixed environment. Advanced command of Microsoft O365, Salesforce.com and partner websites to streamline operations, enhance cross-functional efficiency, and inform executive-level decision-making.

jobDescription:
Title: Program Manager – Global Marketing Operations Location: Bengaluru Shift: 10am to 7pm Website https://ascendion.com/ About Ascendion Ascendion is a leader in AI-powered software engineering, helping businesses innovate faster, smarter, and with greater impact. We partner with Global 2000 clients across North America, UK, Europe, and APAC to solve complex challenges in data, experience design, software product engineering, and workforce transformation. Powered by expert engineers, thousands of AI agents, and our Engineering to the Power of AI™ (Engineering AI) method, we deliver measurable outcomes that build trust, unlock value, and accelerate growth. Learn more at ascendion.com Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us: Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands Solve complex problems – and learn new skills Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience Job Description: Role Overview We’re looking for a highly driven Program Manager who can bring operational excellence, accountability, and execution rigor across Ascendion’s campaigns, brand storytelling, leadership positioning, digital execution, events, design, stakeholder management, and growth initiatives. This is not a passive coordination role. You will act as a force multiplier to ensure ideas move from strategy to execution with speed and precision. You’ll work closely with senior marketing leaders, agencies, regional stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure work gets done, timelines stay on track, and impact gets delivered. You should thrive in fast-moving environments, confidently interface with stakeholders at all levels, and know how to push execution forward independently. If you love bringing order to complexity to deliver impact from ambitious marketing programs, this role is for you. Key Responsibilities
1. Drive End-to-End Marketing Program Execution Program manage strategic marketing initiatives across brand, digital, campaigns, communications, content, and events Ensure program tracking, reporting, and execution, ensuring timelines, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables move seamlessly Build and manage execution plans, trackers, workflows, review cadences, and reporting mechanisms across multiple workstreams Ensure initiatives move from planning to completion with operational discipline and visibility
2. Become the Operational Backbone of Marketing Interface with marketing leaders, agencies, creative teams, vendors, and external partners Drive accountability across stakeholders while maintaining strong working relationships Follow up proactively and ensure momentum is never lost across projects Anticipate bottlenecks early and help unblock teams to keep execution moving
3. Work at the Intersection of Marketing + AI Use AI tools and intelligent workflows to improve productivity across project management, reporting, campaign coordination, event execution, and operational planning Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows and improve execution efficiency across the marketing organization Bring an AI-first mindset to how modern marketing teams operate, collaborate, and scale
4. Manage High-Impact Marketing Initiatives Support planning and execution of key events, leadership roundtables, customer engagements, conferences, and flagship brand initiatives Coordinate vendors, logistics, creative assets, communications, attendee management, and execution timelines Ensure campaigns, launches, and events execute with attention to detail and brand consistency Partner with design, content, digital, and campaign teams to operationalize marketing priorities effectively
5. Bring Structure, Visibility & Reporting Build dashboards, status reports, trackers, and executive summaries to improve visibility across marketing initiatives Help teams stay aligned on priorities, timelines, risks, and progress Introduce scalable operational processes that improve marketing efficiency and collaboration Required Skills:- Have an MBA (preferred), or equivalent experience, with 3–4 years in program management, marketing operations, campaign co-ordination, consulting, or AI-led business transformation environments Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and naturally proactive Can confidently communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams Know how to drive work forward diplomatically but firmly Thrive in high-accountability, fast-paced environments with multiple moving priorities Have experience working with agencies, vendors, events, or marketing teams Are curious about AI-native ways of working and operational excellence Believe great marketing requires not just creativity — but exceptional execution Why Join Ascendion? Ascendion is building at the intersection of AI, engineering, and business transformation. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and the opportunity to create impact is massive. This role offers a front-row seat to how a modern global marketing organization operates across brand, growth, leadership positioning, campaigns, digital, and events. You won’t just coordinate projects. You’ll help orchestrate how a global marketing engine runs. You’ll work in a team that values ownership, speed, collaboration, intelligent experimentation, and operational excellence — while helping shape the future of marketing in an AI-first world. Experience a community of change makers! Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

title: Manager - Administration & Facilities
minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration / Engineering / Operations.
jobDescription:
Job Title: Administration Operations
- Manager Location: Bangalore Role Overview The role will be responsible for leading the administration, infrastructure, logistics, and workplace operations teams, globally. The role requires a strategic leader with proven expertise in managing big teams to plan, upkeep and Manage – Infrastructure (Real estate and Operations), Capex, Logistics, BCP and EHS for all sites of Ascendion globally. The role will also develop the sustainability goals and will be responsible for Compliance management (Statutory and Regulatory and Sustainability). Key Responsibilities Administration & Workplace Operations (Globally) Lead end-to-end facilities management, security, housekeeping, transport, cafeteria, and employee services across multiple geographies. Budget and forecasting for Operational expenses for all the facilities Establish policies and SOPs to ensure operational excellence, safety, and compliance. Drive sustainability initiatives (green buildings, energy optimization, waste management). Plan and strive for facility related Recognitions and Accreditation (like IGBC, Golden Peacock Sustainability etc.) Run Daily/monthly/Quarterly Dashboards for above Business Continuity Planning & Crisis Management Establish and maintain a BCP and disaster recovery framework for all global operations Conduct regular risk assessments, audits, and simulation drills Lead crisis response and ensure minimal disruption during contingencies (e.g., natural disasters, IT outages, health emergencies)
3. Logistics & Global Support Services Manage domestic and international logistics, offsite warehousing, and distribution to support business continuity Build strong vendor relationships to ensure uninterrupted supply and cost-effectiveness Standardize global operations while accommodating local statutory requirements
4. Leadership & Governance Develop and mentor a high-performing operations and facilities team across regions Report operational performance, risks, and cost savings to senior leadership Leverage technology platforms for automation, monitoring, and reporting
5. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Own HSE strategy and compliance across all facilities, ensuring adherence to local and international regulations. Implement workplace safety programs, audits, and incident management systems. Promote a safety-first culture, with training and awareness programs for employees and contractors. Key Skills & Competencies Deep knowledge of Business Continuity Management (ISO 22301 preferred ) . Hands-on experience in global administration, workplace, and logistics operations. Strong financial acumen for budgeting and investment planning. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication management and crisis management skills. Familiarity with ERP/operations platforms (Oracle, Net Suite, SAP, etc.) is an advantage. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration / Engineering / Operations. MBA preferred. 15+ years of progressive experience in operations, infrastructure, or facilities management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. Proven track record in managing CAPEX projects and global workplace operations. Prior experience in ITES/Technology/Global MNC environments preferred. Key Success Metrics Effective BCP framework with minimal operational downtime during disruptions. Compliance with global and regional statutory requirements. Enhanced employee satisfaction with global workplace and support services. Improved cost efficiency and sustainability outcomes across operations.

jobDescription:
Ascendion is looking for a Timesheet Executive who will be responsible for collecting approved timecards of our Employees and Consultant from the clients they are associated with which in turn would initiate the process of Revenue generation. A Timesheet Executive will compute earnings of workers by referring to their annual salary or timesheet to discover hours worked. What you’ll do · Perform day to daytime card transactions including verifying & recording in system by understanding and learning the timesheet workflow in the system. · Understand the schedule of procuring timesheets from clients and collecting approved timecards. Gather the understanding of ST/OT hours and US state payroll rules. · Verify discrepancies and resolve timecard issues. Follow up on missing timecards. · Data Analysis of approved/pending timecards to identify reason trends and work with stake owners to get resolution. · You should be able to handle complaints or questions regarding timesheet discrepancies. · Ensure Time & Attendance records are submitted on every employee within established deadlines · Communicate with all necessary parties to research and resolve rejected and other timesheet issues. · Regular follow-up with clients is mandatory What You’ll Need · Exceptional interpersonal skills; communications skills
- specifically written and oral · Bachelor's degree in commerce · Well versed with MS Office, basic Excel skills are must · Job requires being careful about detail and thorough in completing work tasks. · Willingness to work in a calling & communicating profile. Bonus Points If · Ability to resolve conflict · Ability to convince · Active Listening
- Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

jobDescription: Role Summary We are looking for a senior Pre-Sales Consultant to lead UX-led deal shaping and growth across complex enterprise engagements. This role sits at the intersection of experience strategy, solutioning, and commercial rigor, partnering with Sales, UX Leadership, and Delivery to win high-value design and experience transformation programs. You will be responsible for shaping and closing UX engagements ranging from $100K initiatives to multi-million-dollar programs, positioning UX as a measurable, outcome-driven business investment. What You’ll Do UX Pre-Sales & Deal Leadership · Lead the full UX pre-sales lifecycle across opportunity qualification, discovery, solutioning, proposals, SOWs, and executive-level pitches · Partner with Sales early in the pursuit to shape deal strategy, qualify opportunities, and position UX as a strategic growth lever · Own UX deal shaping for enterprise pursuits, ensuring clarity across scope, delivery approach, staffing models, and success metrics Solutioning & Offering Design · Design and articulate scalable UX engagement models across user research, experience strategy, service design, design operations, accessibility, and emerging-technology UX · Translate complex client challenges into outcome-driven UX programs aligned to business objectives and enterprise delivery realities · Partner with UX leadership to evolve differentiated UX offerings, frameworks, and transformation narratives Commercial Structuring & Deal Governance · Structure and optimize commercials across fixed-price, time-and-materials, retainer, and outcome-based engagement models · Maintain margin discipline through clear assumptions, scope boundaries, and risk identification during pre-sales · Establish deal governance practices that enable predictable delivery and smooth transition from pre-sales to execution Executive Engagement & Storytelling · Lead executive storytelling through compelling proposals, POVs, pitch decks, case studies, and UX capability narratives · Engage VP and C-level client stakeholders across Product, Design, Engineering, and Business as a trusted advisor · Position UX consistently as a measurable, outcome-driven business investment Sales Enablement & Practice Scale · Build and maintain reusable pre-sales assets, offerings, and playbooks that improve proposal quality, speed, and consistency · Enable Sales and UX leaders with clear deal narratives, standardized materials, and best practices · Contribute to faster sales cycles and stronger win rates through clearer solutioning and repeatable approaches What You Bring · 6–10+ years in pre-sales, solution consulting, preference design / creative consulting · Proven experience shaping and supporting $100K to multi-million-dollar UX or digital transformation deals · Strong understanding of end-to-end creative disciplines and enterprise delivery models · Executive-level storytelling, commercial structuring, and deal-shaping expertise · Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution Why This Role This is a high-impact role with direct visibility into senior leadership, major accounts, and strategic growth initiatives. You will play a key role in scaling UX as a core growth engine, not just a delivery function. What Success Looks Like in 12 Months Twelve months into the role, you will be successful if: · You are a trusted pre-sales partner to Sales, UX, and Delivery leaders on high-stakes pursuits · You have directly shaped or materially facilitated a strong UX-led pipeline, including multiple $500K+ opportunities · Proposal quality, clarity, and executive storytelling have visibly improved across the UX practice · Reusable UX offerings, proposal assets, and POVs are actively used across multiple deals · Sales cycles are faster and more predictable due to clearer solutioning and commercial structure · UX is consistently positioned with clients as a strategic, outcome-driven investment About Ascendion Ascendion is a global provider of AI-first software engineering services, partnering with enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe to build, modernize, and scale digital platforms with speed and confidence. Headquartered in New Jersey, Ascendion helps organizations reduce technical debt, improve engineering productivity, and accelerate time to value by combining deep technical expertise with world-class talent. With more than 11,000 Ascenders across 40+ offices in 12 countries, eight delivery hubs, and three AI Studios, Ascendion operates at global scale while staying closely aligned to client outcomes. Our capabilities span Applied AI, Cloud, Data, Experience, Platform Engineering, Product Engineering, and Quality Engineering, serving industries including BFSI, Communications, Media & Entertainment, Retail & Consumer Goods, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Hi-Tech, and Energy & Utilities. Ascendion is building toward a generative enterprise. We apply Generative AI not only in the solutions we deliver, but in how we operate and run our engineering value chain. Our focus is on helping enterprise leaders unlock real, measurable value from Gen AI, moving beyond experimentation to production-grade impact. Industry analysts continue to recognize Ascendion as a leader among global services providers, and we are proud to be consistently named a Great Place to Work.

jobDescription: Role Summary We are seeking a highly accomplished Cloud Sub Practice Lead to lead the strategy, growth, and execution of a high-impact cloud practice within our Platform Engineering organization. This leadership role combines business ownership, technology vision, solutioning excellence, and people leadership to accelerate enterprise cloud transformation for global clients. The ideal candidate has 18+ years of experience building and scaling cloud businesses, shaping large transformation programs, leading enterprise architecture, and partnering with sales and customers to drive growth. Beyond technical expertise, the candidate should demonstrate strong commercial acumen, the ability to influence executive stakeholders, and a passion for building high-performing teams, differentiated offerings, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities. Key Responsibilities Practice Strategy & Business Growth Define and execute the vision, strategy, and growth roadmap for the Cloud Sub Practice aligned with the Platform Engineering strategy. Own practice health, including revenue growth, profitability, utilization, customer success, capability maturity, and talent development. Develop differentiated cloud offerings, industry solutions, accelerators, reusable assets, and AI-enabled frameworks that improve delivery velocity and business outcomes. Identify emerging technology trends and convert them into scalable business opportunities. Build strategic relationships with hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) and technology partners. Solutioning & Enterprise Architecture Lead solution architecture for strategic cloud transformation programs across application modernization, cloud-native engineering, data platforms, AI workloads, integration, and platform engineering. Architect secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized multi-cloud solutions aligned with enterprise architecture principles. Drive architecture governance, design reviews, and technical decision-making across engagements. Champion modern engineering practices including microservices, Kubernetes, containers, Dev Sec Ops, Fin Ops, Infrastructure as Code, platform engineering, and AI-assisted software delivery. Business Development & Client Advisory Partner with Sales, Client Partners, and Account Leaders to build qualified pipeline and win strategic cloud opportunities. Lead CXO conversations, executive workshops, cloud assessments, and transformation roadmap discussions. Own technical strategy for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and executive presentations. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers throughout their cloud transformation journey. Delivery Excellence Provide executive oversight for strategic cloud engagements to ensure successful execution, customer satisfaction, predictable outcomes, and commercial success. Establish delivery governance, architecture standards, quality frameworks, and operational best practices. Proactively manage delivery risks and act as the executive escalation point for critical engagements. Drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, reusable assets, and engineering productivity. Practice Building & Talent Development Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing organization of cloud architects, consultants, engineers, and technical leaders. Define competency frameworks, certification roadmaps, learning programs, and career progression paths. Drive strategic hiring aligned with practice growth plans. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Innovation & Thought Leadership Drive innovation through AI-native engineering, cloud automation, accelerators, proof-of-concepts, and innovation labs. Build intellectual property that differentiates the practice in the marketplace. Publish thought leadership including whitepapers, blogs, reference architectures, and case studies. Represent the organization at customer events, analyst briefings, partner forums, and industry conferences. Required Qualifications 18+ years of experience in enterprise technology, cloud consulting, solution architecture, or platform engineering. Proven track record of building and scaling cloud practices, Centers of Excellence (Co Es), or consulting organizations. Demonstrated success leading large cloud transformation programs across multiple industries. Strong expertise in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, with multi-cloud architecture experience preferred. Deep understanding of: Cloud-native architecture Kubernetes & Containers Microservices Dev Sec Ops Platform Engineering Infrastructure as Code Cloud Security Fin Ops Observability Experience leading large strategic deals from qualification through solutioning and delivery. Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills with experience engaging CXOs and senior business leaders. Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications Cloud certifications (AWS Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect). Experience with AI/ML platforms, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or AI-assisted engineering. Experience with regulated industries such as Banking, Healthcare, Insurance, Retail, or Manufacturing. Experience building reusable cloud platforms, engineering accelerators, and internal developer platforms. Exposure to hyperscaler partner programs and joint GTM initiatives. Success Metrics The successful candidate will be measured on: Practice revenue growth Pipeline creation and deal influence Win rate for strategic cloud opportunities Gross margin and delivery profitability Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) Delivery quality and successful green starts Growth of reusable IP, accelerators, and AI-enabled assets Talent retention, capability development, and certification growth Innovation, thought leadership, and market differentiation
